data.name: Ayanik
data.long_meaning: Ayanik is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ayan', meaning journey, and 'Nik', meaning new or beginning. This name is given to a child who is believed to be on a spiritual journey or a traveler in life. In Hindu mythology, Ayanik is also the name of a celestial being who is the guardian of the north direction.
